House GOP Tries to Line Up Support to Fund Government Through December
videos.description: Today will test whether House Republicans can land a one-two punch on short-term funding priorities this week and clear the decks before their August recess, handing a panoply of difficult considerations to the Senate. GOP leadership has teed up votes today to pass a continuing resolution that would fund the government between Oct. 1 and Dec. 4 in hopes of avoiding a shutdown during the midterms. Brian Gardner, Chief Washington Policy Strategist at Stifel, discusses what's on tap for congress this week, as well as the outlook for both Democrats and Republicans heading into midterms. -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: Novartis CEO on 2Q Profit Beat, Investing in Pipeline
videos.description: Novartis reported better-than-expected sales and earnings for the second quarter, driven by strong performance from its new cancer medicines which offset declining sales of its former blockbuster drug Entresto. CEO Vas Narasimhan discussed the company's strategic focus on navigating significant patent expiries in the first half of the year, followed by a growth phase in the second half fueled by investments in the pipeline and new product launches. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Katie Greifeld on "The Close." -------- More on Bloomberg Television and Markets Like this video? videos.title: New Jersey Says 6,600 Noncitizens were mistakenly registered to vote
videos.description: New Jersey Governor Mikie Sherrill said about 6,600 people who identified themselves as noncitizens were registered to vote between June 2023 and June 2024 due to a software error in the state’s motor vehicle system, an admission that could fan Republican claims about voter fraud.
